problems.title: Two subsequence limits
problems.question: Xₙ=1+1/n for odd n and −2+1/n for even n. Find its limit.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: The odd subsequence tends to 1; the even subsequence tends to −2.
steps: A convergent sequence has the same limit along every subsequence. These limits differ.

problems.title: What an absolute-value limit guarantees
problems.question: Given|Xₙ|→5 and Yₙ=2Xₙ, which listed conclusion must hold?
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: The product tends to 2·25=50. Xₙ itself may alternate signs, so a signed limit need not exist.

problems.title: Angle between two lines
problems.question: Find the cosine between5x+3y−2=0 and √17x−√17y+5=0.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: Use normals(5,3) and(1,−1). The acute line-angle cosine is|n₁·n₂|/(|n₁||n₂|).

problems.title: Two points equally distant from a line
problems.question: A=(−1, a), B=(−1, b) are distinct and both √10 from y=−3x. Find AB.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: At x=−1,|y−3|=10, so y=13 or −7. Their separation is 20.

problems.title: An exponential limit
problems.question: Find lim(1+3/n)^(2n+1).
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: Write the expression as[(1+3/n)ⁿ]²(1+3/n). The limit is e⁶.

problems.title: Leading coefficients in a rational limit
problems.question: Find lim(3n³+8n²−6)/(−n³+2n²+n).
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: Divide numerator and denominator by n³.
steps: All reciprocal powers vanish; the limit is 3/(−1)=−3.

problems.title: Differentiate a variable power
problems.question: For f(x)=(x²+1)^(2x), find f′(0).
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: At x=0, both terms vanish and f(0)=1. Thus f′(0)=0.

problems.title: Continuity at two joins
problems.question: f=a on[−0.5,0.5] and f=1/x² outside. Find a for continuity.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: The outer limits at both endpoints equal1/(0.5)²=4.
steps: The constant inner value must match them, so a=4.

problems.title: Cone,cylinder and sphere surface ratio
problems.question: A cylinder has square axial section, a circumsphere, and an inscribed cone with common base. Find cone lateral:cylinder lateral:sphere are a.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: Let radius r, height 2r. Cone slant=r√5; sphere radius=r√2.
steps: The areas are πr²√5,4πr², and 8πr². Cancelπr².

problems.title: An exponential dominates logarithmic growth
problems.question: Find lim as x→∞ of ln(1/x)/(eˣ/x).
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: For example, two applications of l’Hôpital reduce x ln x/eˣ to(1/x)/eˣ→0. The original limit is 0.

problems.title: Stationary points of inverse functions
problems.question: Count roots of f′(x)=0 for f=arctanx+arccosx.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: Equality gives √(1−x²)=1+x². Squaring yields x²(x²+3)=0. Only x=0 is real and it satisfies the original equation.

problems.title: Recognize a derivative limit
problems.question: Given f′=2x+2, g′=3−x, find lim as a→0 of[f(x+a)+2g(x+a)−f(x)−2g(x)]/a.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: The value is 2x+2+2(3−x)=8.

problems.question: A frustum has radii1,4 and height 4. Find lateral are a.

problems.title: A second-order limit
problems.question: Find lim as x→0 of sin²x/(eˣ−x−1).
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: The quotient tends to x²/(x²/2)=2. Equivalently, two l’Hôpital differentiations give2/1.

problems.title: Triangle formed by three lines
problems.question: Find the are a bounded by y=x+2, y=−2x+5, y=−x/2+2.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: Area=half the absolute determinant of(1,1),(2,−1), or|−3|/2=1.5.

problems.title: Distance from a line to a parabola
problems.question: Find the minimum distance between y=x−3 and y=x².
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: For a parabola point(t, t²), the line distance is|t²−t+3|/√2.
steps: Complete the square:t²−t+3=(t−1/2)²+11/4. Its minimum is 11/4.

problems.title: Stationary points of a composed sine square
problems.question: For f(x)=sin²(√(1−x²)), count roots of f′=0.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: The sine factor is positive because its argument lies in(0,2]. Thus the only root is x=0. Endpoints are not interior points of the real domain and are not ordinary derivative roots.

problems.title: Intercept of an exponential tangent
problems.question: Find where the tangent to y=2ˣ at(1,2) meets the x-axis.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: Set y=0 to get x=1−1/ln2=log₂(2/e).

problems.title: Insphere-to-cone volume ratio
problems.question: A cone has height 9, radius 12 and an insphere. Find sphere volume:cone volume.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: Slant=15. The axial triangle inradius is r=Rh/(R+l)=12·9/27=4.
steps: Sphere volume=256π/3; cone volume=π·144·9/3=432π. Their ratio is 16/81.

problems.title: Tangent to a cubic through an external point
problems.question: A tangent to y=x³ passes through(0,−16). Find the sum of its contact-point coordinates.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: The tangent at t is y=3t²x−2t³.
steps: Its y-intercept gives −2t³=−16, so t=2. The contact point is(2,8), whose coordinate sum is 10.

problems.title: Perpendicular slopes from intercept distance
problems.question: Two perpendicular lines through(3, a) meet the y-axis9 apart. Find|k₁+k₂|.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: Then(k₁+k₂)²=(k₁−k₂)²+4k₁k₂=9−4=5.

problems.title: Cylinder proportions from surface areas
problems.question: A cylinder is inscribed in a sphere whose surface are a is twice its total surface are a. Find diameter:height.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
steps: Substitution cancels4πr² and gives h²=4rh. Since h>0, h=4r. Diameter:height=2r:4r=1:2.

problems.title: One line tangent to opposite parabolas
problems.question: The line y=kx+k touches y=x²+2x+3 and its negative. Find contact-point separation.
problems.idea: Apply the relevant limit, derivative, distance, or solid-geometry formula.
formulas: Tangency discriminants both give k²−8=0. Contact abscissas are(k−2)/2 and −(k+2)/2.
steps: Their difference is k; the ordinate difference on the line is k²=8. Distance=√(k²+k⁴)=√72=6√2.
